editorial:
Imagine moving into a new place only to start getting mysterious boxes filled with human body parts. That is exactly what happens to Tom Riley in this wild ride. The previous owner of his house wants him to play doctor and sew together a perfect boyfriend for her. Tom has zero medical skills, but he is totally broke and desperate for cash, so he agrees to the creepy deal. The vibe is a great mix of gross-out humor and genuine tension that keeps you guessing if the whole thing is a prank or a nightmare.

You will love how the movie balances the silly bits with the scary moments. The acting is spot on, especially the way Tom panics as he tries to put the puzzle together. While the middle part drags a little bit, the payoff at the end is worth it. If you are into weird comedies, you should definitely check this out. It looks amazing in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: At the end, the monster finally wakes up, but he is not the loving partner the owner wanted. He turns out to be a violent killer who starts attacking everyone in the house. Tom discovers the owner was actually a serial killer herself who just wanted a loyal henchman. After a messy fight, Tom manages to trick the monster into a trap, destroying him for good and finally getting rid of the nightmare.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and monster movies.
